brief:
Middle East Eye has identified the operator behind "Habibi," an anonymous X account that campaigns against pro-Palestine public figures in the UK, as an American-British grandson of a philosopher. The account has attacked figures including former Labour leader Ed Miliband, labeling him "Palestine Secretary," and has targeted UK Muslim activists through what the outlet describes as smear campaigns.

The revelation comes as the account continues to present itself as an "expert researcher" while operating anonymously on the social media platform. The account's activities have drawn scrutiny for their role in a broader pattern of coordinated online campaigns against pro-Palestine advocacy in Britain.

title: Anonymous X account smearing UK Muslims tied to philosopher's descendant
